basis: Absent ovulation is a reproductive dysfunction; no endocrine disorder is specified.
PDHX deficiency defines a metabolic disorder with neurologic dysfunction; seizures, spasticity and callosal abnormalities occur in 30–79%.
Middle-ear effusion defines the disease; effusion alone does not establish active infection or an immune-mediated disease.
Ependymal tumor arising in the posterior fossa of the central nervous system.
Hereditary skeletal muscle disease; myalgia, elevated creatine kinase and possible rhabdomyolysis define the phenotype.
Benign keratotic lesion arising from cutaneous follicular structures.
Iris stromal depigmentation and anterior segment abnormalities define this ocular disease; preceding respiratory infection is not organ involvement.
Combined immunodeficiency with hyper-IgE; chronic eczema is common (>30%). Recurrent respiratory infections alone do not establish lasting lung injury.
INS-related monogenic diabetes; retinopathy, nephropathy and other diabetic complications are separately diagnosed diseases.
Skeletal muscle channelopathy defined by periodic paralysis and hypokalemia; dyspnea does not establish pulmonary damage.
Carcinoma originates in adrenal cortex. Renal ancestry conflicts with the definition; another TP53-associated tumor is a separate disease.
Peripheral vestibular dysfunction is an inner-ear disorder; vertigo alone does not establish central neurologic disease.
Benign reproductive gonadal tumor umbrella, including fibromatous tumors; endocrine dysfunction is not established across the group.
Disease of peripheral autonomic nerves; downstream autonomic symptoms do not establish direct damage to their target organs.
Inherited porokeratosis affects skin; an FDPS variant alone does not establish a systemic metabolic disorder.
Germ-cell tumor of the reproductive testis; no endocrine tissue origin or other qualifying organ involvement is specified.
GI polyposis and vascular malformations define syndrome; pulmonary AVMs ~70%, chronic bleeding anemia ~86%. Hepatic AVMs often preserve liver function; stroke <30%.
Squamous carcinoma arises in the skin of the external ear, a site covered by both cutaneous and external-ear axes.
Inherited hypertrophic narrowing of the gastric pylorus; secondary electrolyte disturbances do not define this subtype.
Neurodegenerative iron-metabolism disorder defined by brain iron accumulation and progressive neurologic dysfunction; other organs vary by subtype.
Chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease; asthma and allergic rhinitis are separate diseases, and damaging ocular complications are uncommon.
Hamartomatous polyp arising in colonic mucosa; local inflammation does not establish an immune-mediated disease.
Syndrome defined by cardiomyopathy with cutaneous or hair abnormalities, including keratoderma and woolly hair.
Nodular hyperplasia of adrenal cortex, often causing autonomous cortisol secretion; associated Carney-complex lesions are not intrinsic to this concept.
Meningococcal bloodstream infection; bacteremia alone is not blood-cell disease. DIC, vascular injury and adrenal damage vary with severity; a ≥30% rate is unestablished.
